 Ontada is looking for a talented team player who wants to solve novel problems and help us build and deliver our Genospace software platform.  Your work as a Software Engineer in the Genospace team at Ontada will impact individuals and organizations across the healthcare landscape: patients searching for the best treatment options, researchers seeking to make advances based on a sea of high\-dimensional data, physicians deploying personalized medicine in everyday practice, and laboratories conducting some of the most advanced analyses in the world.

* Experience with front end tech, back\-end tech and data base technology
* A demonstrable ability to design software to meet functional and technical requirements and to communicate your designs effectively
* Ability to consider problems creatively and critically while collaborating with product owners, data scientists, and designers in order to come up with solutions

 Amazon Industrial Robotics is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting\-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments.  If you’re passionate about safety and performance and have an interest in robotics systems, then we’d like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customers.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Requirements**
 The ideal candidate is enthusiastic about building the right solutions for our customers and will collaborate with other teams to ensure that our product meets Amazon\-scale requirements. They will:
   

  

* Develop embedded software for controlling complex mechatronic systems.

* Contribute to the architecture of these complex systems and work effectively with team members to implement solutions.
* Develop solutions that balance performance and maintainability under the guidance of senior engineers.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Software Engineer you will work within cross functional teams to develop, test, and debug both our low\-level sensing and motor control firmware and integrate it into a mid\-level real time software controlling the entire robotic system. * Direct, hands\-on experience with developing and debugging complex embedded systems

* 2\+ years of experience developing embedded C applications that use an RTOS (such as FreeRTOS, uC\-OS, Zephyr, VxWorks, QNX) and embedded Linux environments


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* 3\+ years of experience in developing and maintaining robotics control systems in Simulink in a Hardware\-In\-the\-Loop setting, and transferring the results to an operational robotic system
* 4\+ years of development experience within an embedded environment or with robotic systems
* Experience with open\-source Linux\-based development tools and architectures
* Embedded development of Machine Learning applications

**Description**
 As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do \-\- with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need to see what agents did, control what agents can do, and prove both to auditors. Our team builds the systems that make this possible. We record every agent desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and package the evidence for compliance frameworks.
   

  

 We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly, deliver features end\-to\-end, and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production, make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services, and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high and the roadmap is concrete, with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year. The team is small enough that your work goes to production fast and visibly. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents, this team is for you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own features end\-to\-end: design, implement, test, deploy, and operate in production
* Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows
* Integrate with AWS services and make build\-vs\-compose decisions with your team
* Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines, retention, and access controls where correctness is the product
* Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces
* Contribute to operational excellence: oncall, runbooks, alarms, and incident response


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your mornings are usually free for focus work — writing code, reviewing CRs, and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work, cross\-team syncs, or design reviews. The team is small, so you'll know what everyone is working on, and when something breaks, the whole team rallies. Our pipelines are full CD, our ticket queue is small, and when something pages us we fix the root cause — not just the symptom. We encourage responsible AI usage across our development workflow — it's one way our small team moves fast. The problems are interesting and the pace is high, but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it.
   

  

 We're a small team building two greenfield projects within Agentic WorkSpaces. We're moving fast enough that our team name is still taking shape — but our engineering culture is well established.
